components.name: Parchment Button
components.css: .ds-btn-parchment { background:#F6E2B9; color:#2A1B14; border:2px solid #3A2418; border-radius:3px; padding:9px 16px; min-height:40px; font:600 14px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-btn-parchment:hover { background:#E2A93B; } .ds-btn-parchment:focus-visible { outline:2px dashed #E2A93B; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Wood Button
components.description: Mode-changing action within the guild shell.
components.css: .ds-btn-wood { background:#694228; color:#FFF2D0; border:2px solid #E2A93B; border-radius:3px; padding:9px 16px; min-height:40px; font:600 14px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-btn-wood:hover { background:#E2A93B; color:#2A1B14; } .ds-btn-wood:focus-visible { outline:2px dashed #E2A93B; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background:#9B3F32; color:#FFF2D0; border:2px solid #FFF2D0; border-radius:3px; padding:9px 16px; min-height:40px; font:600 14px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:#E2A93B; color:#2A1B14; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px dashed #E2A93B; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Parchment Panel
components.css: .ds-panel { background:#F6E2B9; color:#2A1B14; border:3px solid #3A2418; border-radius:5px; padding:24px; font:400 14px/1.5 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-panel h2 { margin:0 0 16px; font-size:20px; line-height:1.3; }

components.name: Journey Navigation
components.css: .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:12px; background:#F6E2B9; color:#2A1B14; padding:24px; font:400 14px 'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color:#526A3A; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:2px dashed #E2A93B; outline-offset:2px; } .ds-nav-active { font-weight:600; }

narrative.overview: The interface feels like a practical notice board inside a bright adventurer guild. Medieval flavor comes from material, palette, copy, and approved pixel art while familiar Windows controls keep the utility immediate.
keyCharacteristics: One visual mode at a time

rules.name: The Two-Ink Rule
rules.body: Use Quest Ink on parchment and Campfire Cream on wood.

rules.name: The Utility First Rule
rules.body: Do not use decorative lettering for controls or data.

dos: Do keep functional text on opaque surfaces.
Do share one material vocabulary across modes.
donts: Don't place body text directly on the illustration.
Don't use gold as decorative body copy.
Don't add ambient motion before Reduced Motion support.
